integrity: Algebraic proof and reproducible self-review; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: One vertex removed from a rectangular rook graph; finite fields of characteristic two; synchronous neighbor sums without self-feedback. Does not address multiple deletions, other characteristic or nonlinear rules. Related intact-rook results were already known. Priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent work.
title: A single missing rook square changes the parity dynamical phase and creates a five-step Jordan chain
